dedupe_keys.name: plant level decarbonisation pathways and mitigation cost of global oil refineries ma meng guan and others

description: This dataset holds the numerical results of a study of plant-level decarbonisation pathways and mitigation costs for the world's oil refineries. The latest Zenodo version (3 January 2026) lists a workbook of plant-level, process-unit-based carbon emissions for global refineries, future economic costs and learning rates of technologies from 2021 to 2070, real-world examples, emission and cost uncertainty tables and the figure data, nine files of about 0.6 MB in all; an earlier May 2024 version held only the figure data, and the model code is a separate linked record. It was published by nine authors (Shijun Ma, Jing Meng, Tianyang Lei, Kailan Tian, Liang Jing, Hassan El-Houjeiri, Diling Liang, Peipei Chen and Dabo Guan), free to download under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is global refineries. Caveats: the affiliations are not stated on the record read, and results depend on the study's cost and technology assumptions. For simulation it gives refinery-by-refinery emissions and abatement options to model how refinery closures or conversions change fuel supply and emissions. Related catalogue records include the global refinery infrastructure and petroleum trade data and the global site-specific health impacts of fossil plants and refineries.
